sourceDocuments.title: ICT Integration in Senior Secondary Mathematics
sourceDocuments.text: Computer-assisted instructional software significantly enhances student geometric visualization and algebraic concept retention compared to chalk-and-talk methods.

studentDocument.title: Mother-Tongue Instruction in Early Childhood Classrooms
studentDocument.text: Teaching initial reading in Yoruba or Hausa during the first three years of schooling accelerates cognitive development and eases subsequent English-medium second language acquisition.

labelRationale: Negative control: student wrote on early language policy; source is computer mathematics software.
